content: The American Diabetes Association (ADA) has identified GLP-1 receptor agonists (GLP-1 RAs) as a class of medications that includes dulaglutide, exenatide, and semaglutide. These medications have a significant range in their Average Wholesale Price (AWP), which spans from $895 to $1,430, and their National Average Drug Acquisition Cost (NADAC), which ranges from $671 to $1,072. The approved daily doses for these drugs vary depending on the specific formulation, with some formulations designed for weekly administration.
